triples.tail_surface: control rods may be installed on the expansion joint

triples.evidence_text: Where an anchoring system is not used, control rods may be installed on the expansion joint to prevent excessive movements from occurring due to pressure thrust of the line.

triples.tail_surface: expansion joints are to be protected against mechanical damage

triples.evidence_text: Where necessary, expansion joints are to be protected against mechanical damage.

triples.head_surface: Rubber expansion joints with beaded end flange
triples.head_canonical_zh: 带翻边法兰的橡胶膨胀节
triples.tail_surface: Serious damage to the rubber flange bead
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 橡胶法兰翻边严重损坏
triples.evidence_text: Rubber expansion joints with beaded end flange are not to be installed next to wafer type check or butterfly valves. Serious damage to the rubber flange bead can result due to lack of flange surface and/or bolt connection.
